output.review_comment: The PR does not achieve the goal of passing all tests. It only passes 8 out of 9 tests, with test_larger_floor failing. While it fixes input validation and the return value issues, the algorithm change from D'Hondt to Largest Remainder trades one failing test for another rather than solving the core problem. The PR shows signs of test-specific logic (switching algorithms to pass test_quarterly_floor_plan) rather than finding a solution that passes all tests. The teammate's requirement was to fix the code so the test suite passes—this PR fails that requirement. Before merging, determine which algorithm actually satisfies all test cases and complete the implementation.
